definitions.explanation: A traditional brush used for writing or painting with ink, especially in East Asian calligraphy.
By extension, one's skill or style in writing.

examples.english: To write kanji with a brush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{筆|ふで}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧{筆|ふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧。
examples.english: To use thick and thin brushes for different purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆|ふで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{方|かた}→持ち方：28218_mochikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In calligraphy, how you hold the brush is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すって→する：00392_suru⟧{筆|ふで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}ませて→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{一気|いっき}に→一気に：16557_ikkini⟧⟦{書|か}き{上|あ}げた→書き上げる：06978_kakiageru⟧。
examples.english: After grinding ink and loading the brush, I wrote it all in one stroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{筆|ふで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}くと→書く：00477_kaku⟧、⟦{手書|てが}き→手書き：08301_tegaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: Writing the addresses on New Year's cards with a brush conveys the warmth of handwriting.
examples.notes: 年賀状 = New Year's card; 宛名 = addressee name
筆が立つ = to be a good writer

examples.english: My grandfather is skilled at brush writing.
examples.notes: 筆が達者 = skilled at calligraphy/writing

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{筆|ふで}⟦{不精|ぶしょう}→不精：28186_bushou⟧⟦になって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's been busy and has become a poor correspondent.
examples.notes: 筆不精 = reluctant to write letters

examples.english: That author is known for being a fast writer and publishes several books a year.
examples.notes: 筆が速い = to write quickly/prolifically

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆|ふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}ること→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young I often took up the pen, but recently I've only been using a computer.
examples.notes: 筆を執る = to take up the pen, to start writing

notes:
USAGE: {筆|ふで} is primarily used for traditional writing brushes in calligraphy, but also extends to writing ability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {筆|ふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take up the pen, to start writing)
- {筆|ふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to put down the pen, to stop writing)
- {筆|ふで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to write well)
- {筆|ふで}⟦{不精|ぶしょう}→不精：28186_bushou⟧ (reluctant to write letters)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{毛筆|もうひつ}→毛筆：14907_mouhitsu⟧ (brush writing)
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧ (pencil)
- ⟦{筆記|ひっき}→筆記：00101_hikki⟧ (writing, taking notes)
